result_summary.title: Blank screen on Metrics Engine dashboard in production (ANZ)
result_summary.description: Users in the ANZ production region are reporting a blank white screen when trying to access the Metrics Engine. The page loads the skeleton structure but no data renders. We are also not receiving any expected notification alerts that usually trigger when data ingestion is delayed or if there is a system health warning. It's hard to tell if the blank screen is due to the Metrics Engine failing to render data or if the underlying notification dispatcher is down and blocking the UI initialization. Impact is high as 845 users cannot view their metrics.
